name: The Bodrum EDITION
positioning: EDITION resort on the western point of the Bodrum peninsula, with an infinity pool, a Beach Club and a Michelin-starred restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with a social Beach Club and weekly beach parties
Food-focused travelers drawn to Michelin-starred dining
Groups or families wanting a private villa with its own pool

facts.text: The hotel is 3 kilometers from Yalikavak Marina at the western point of the Bodrum peninsula.
Rooms have warm wood finishes and airy fabrics that give a beach house feel.
Guest room bathrooms have marble, deep soaking tubs, monsoon rain showerheads and Le Labo bath products.
KITCHEN serves contemporary Aegean and Anatolian cuisine led by chef Osman Sezener.
The Trattoria hosts live experiences with artists from the music, art and fashion worlds.
The hotel has an infinity pool and garden lounge that ends at the sea.
The Beach Club offers private beach access, a jetty, private cabanas and towel service.
The spa includes a Turkish Hammam, a salt treatment room and a sauna.
The spa is open to day guests as well as hotel guests.
The gym offers a Pilates room, an indoor cycling studio and a yoga terrace with SUP Yoga.

highlights.text: KITCHEN by Osman Sezener retains its Michelin Star in 2026, the third consecutive year.
The Trattoria partners with Michelin-starred chef Stefano Ciotti to showcase Italian cuisine, starting in the 2024 season.
The Beach Club hosts exclusive weekly beach parties with DJs and entertainers.
Suites feature private plunge pools and terraces.
The four-bedroom private villa has its own swimming pool and sauna area.

considerations.text: Yalikavak Marina is 3 kilometers from the hotel, so the hotel sits at the bay rather than in the marina.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes a sophisticated adult-oriented atmosphere that may not suit families with young children.
